notes: Fifteen Yerba Buena Phase 1 'Subject Property' items of the Redevelopment Agency Records: Hotels (SFH371-5061, 1961), Breen's restaurant (5063, 1972) and the thirteen block files, 5064 to 5076 (blocks 3705-3707, 3722-3724, 3733-3735, 3750-3752 and 3763), read from 100-dpi page images as contact sheets, with the Internet Archive text layer for the typed labels. They are photograph files. The block files' prints carry the 1960s block and lot in red or pencil on the back (3706-12, 3723-109) or a typed 'BLOCK 3735, Lot 9' label on the mount, and no date; the Breen's file is interiors without a caption. Four prints name a building or an address that can be looked up, both 1961 residential hotels on Fourth Street whose sites were cleared for the Yerba Buena Center. The 'Eighty Six Third Street Building' attachment (5065 pp. 19-23) is captioned but undated, so it is not a finding: it names the owning company, Opera Alley on its west side and a west wall showing deterioration and seismic deficiency.

coverage.remaining: In the same Yerba Buena series: Blight (5055-5057), Photos (5058-5059), Contact Sheets (5060), New Start Center (5077) and Demolition (5078). Not read.
coverage.note: Most prints carry a 1960s block and lot alone, in red or pencil on the back or typed on the mount, and no date: below the evidence bar, though many are of buildings that still stand (St. Patrick's Church is block 3706 lots 13-14; 163-165 Jessie is 3707 lot 32). Captions naming a building or an address: 5061 pp. 5-6 (the Goldfield and Imperial hotels, 1961), 5072 p. 6 (the Marine Firemen's building, 3735-55), 5073 p. 14 (651-59 Folsom, 3750-50), 5065 pp. 19-23 (the 86 Third Street Building, undated), 5069 p. 8 (a mission, 3724-4), 5071 pp. 16 and 30 (an industrial firm's property on Howard and Third, 3734-2 and 84-87) 5071 p. 28 (rear of 3734-63, 'not yet acquired by agency'), 5073 pp. 16-18 (673-677 Folsom, 3750-34-35), 5073 p. 28 (136 Hawthorne) and 5074 pp. 16-20 (370-76, 378-80 and 384-86 Third Street, 3751-12, 14 and 15). Every one of these is undated, so only the two hotel prints, which the item dates, became dated findings; the undated Marine Firemen and 651-59 Folsom captions are recorded to show what the files hold. A later run that finds dates for these files (the item notes say they were removed from the Agency's binders) could publish the block-lot prints of standing buildings as dated photographs. 1 resolved and declined, 0 published.
